steps.description: Base tables (profiles, core app tables), uuid-ossp, RLS bootstrap.
Document/inspection/marketing tables + their RLS. Sets an initial role CHECK.
Canonical 6-role CHECK (supersedes #2's), 30-day trial column, handle_new_user() trigger.
Operational BTB tables (prep counts, orders, cleaning schedule).
Compliance register, login vault, emergency contacts, handbook, protocols, new-restaurant tasks + RLS.
Widens business_documents.doc_type to cover every expiring document the vault tracks (licenses, insurance, hood/fire, pest, franchise, lease).
Corrects the profiles select/update policies.
Demo-grade. Opens the compliance/admin tables to public RLS so the cookie-authed Between the Buns surface (no Supabase session) can read/write them. NOT production row security — see the file header.
cleaning_logs.done_time + cleaning_logs.week_start + the public ops-photos Storage bucket and its policies (multi-angle cleaning photos).
emergency_contacts.category + phone_2/phone_3/contact_name/email — the category directory (Electrician, Plumber, Grease Trap…) with 3 preferences per entry.
locations + location_members, profiles.location_id, location_id on prep/order/cleaning + the 3 dashboard-counter tables, urgent flag on PAR sheets, fixed-id seed + membership backfill.
corporate_inspections.inspection_type (corporate / in-house / franchisee share one table), backfills legacy inhouse_inspections rows, opens the table to the BTB tablet.
prep_counts.pull — the Freezer pull & Dairy column of the new Daily Prep Sheet. Run last: until it's run the sheet still reads, but Save refuses with a message naming this file.

marketing_promotions.category / size / person_name / location_id — the promotion form's category, size, person and target site. Needs locations from #11; until it's run the marketing board hides those four inputs.

Widens login_vault.category to the Login Vault's flat category list (Debit machine, Internet, MYR POS, Bank login, Uber …) while keeping every legacy bucket readable. Keep in sync with src/lib/vault-categories.ts.
cash_outs — end-of-day till reconciliation (till, cash sale, delivery fees, tips, cash-out, safe drop) with a 30-day retention purge (purge_cash_outs()).
staff_members + staff_shifts — weekly roster calendar (90-day retention on shifts via purge_staff_schedule()). Needs locations from #11.

corporate_dates — filing deadlines, payroll remittances, licences and renewals with optional monthly/quarterly/annual recurrence. location_id IS NULL = company-wide. Kept forever (a purged deadline would silently vanish from next year's view).
training_topics + training_sections — the SOP/onboarding guide (sections are plain text: paragraphs + - checklist lines, published hides drafts from staff). Kept forever.

inventory_items + inventory_counts — the closing count sheet (count_month is a YYYY-MM key, one row per item per month) with value and variance against the previous close. Retention: 24 months via purge_inventory_counts().

branding_requests — signage/menu/uniform/packaging requests on a status board (open → in_review → in_progress → done/declined). Retention: finished requests older than 24 months via purge_branding_requests(); open work is never purged.

Storage buckets cleaning-photos, inspection-photos, training-videos + their policies (upload targets for uploadToSupabase() in src/lib/files.ts). Existing cleaning/inspection photos stay in ops-photos (#9).
Demo accounts + sample rows (RESETS demo data on re-run — re-apply with --force or --step=23 after editing it).
